tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline the characteristic features of a drainage basin.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a basic familiar system; recall.

units.summary: Analyse projected cumulative greenhouse gas emission changes by country and group, 2015-2030.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a comparative bar graph; variation between groups with data manipulation.

units.summary: With a studied tropical rainforest, analyse factors driving change in the magnitude of carbon stores.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay (AO1=10 AO2=10) analysing stores and transfers in one setting; case study required.

units.summary: Outline sources of sediment in hot deserts.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of weathering, mass movement and wind as sources; recall.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between annual precipitation and temperature in central Chile.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of paired climate variables in a graph; relationships and anomalies.

units.summary: Using a Great Green Wall figure and own knowledge, assess challenges in responding to desertification.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying human response knowledge to unfamiliar scheme data.

units.summary: Assess whether weathering is the most important geomorphological process shaping desert landscapes.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay weighing weathering against wind, water and mass movement; extended evaluation.

units.summary: Outline processes leading to the formation of sand dunes.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a familiar depositional landform; recall.

units.summary: Analyse a figure of 2100 coastal risk under sea level rise and human response scenarios.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a multi-scenario graphic with comparisons across coastal types; no recall.

units.summary: Using an integrated flood management plan figure and own knowledge, assess sustainability of coastal flood risk strategies.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying sustainable management knowledge to a novel plan.

units.summary: With studied coastal environments, analyse factors and processes behind a high energy erosional landscape.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay requiring extended analysis of energy, processes and landforms; case study required.

units.summary: Outline processes leading to the formation of solifluction lobes.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a periglacial landform; recall.

units.summary: Analyse permafrost temperature variation in interior and northern Alaska.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of comparative time-series data; trends and relationships.

units.summary: Using a figure on alpine tundra and own knowledge, assess challenges climate change will pose.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying climate change knowledge to a novel figure.

units.summary: With a studied glaciated landscape, assess whether erosion has been the dominant shaping process.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay weighing erosion against deposition and other processes; case study required.

units.summary: Outline processes involved in forming island arcs.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a plate margin landform; recall.

units.summary: Interpret earthquake probability data for California over a 30-year period.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 interpretation of probability graphs with patterns and anomalies; no recall.

units.summary: Using data on Tropical Storm Megi and own knowledge, assess challenges in responding to such an event.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) applying storm management knowledge to an unfamiliar event.

units.summary: Evaluate the role of economic development in managing wildfires.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluation (AO1=4 AO2=5) linking development level to human response; no data support.

units.summary: Assess future prospects for sustainable human occupation of a studied multi-hazardous environment.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay evaluating resilience and sustainability; case study required.

units.summary: Outline the concept of climatic climax.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single familiar concept; recall.

units.summary: Analyse data on organic carbon stored in different parts of world biomes.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a compound bar graph with data manipulation; no recall.

units.summary: Using a woodland nutrient cycle figure and own knowledge, assess human impacts on nutrient cycling.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) applying nutrient cycling to a novel diagram and evaluating human change.

units.summary: Assess the potential impact of climate change on people living in savanna grasslands.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) with a synoptic climate change link; no data.

units.summary: With a studied coral reef, assess the sustainability of human activity there.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay evaluating pressures and sustainability; named reef required.
